Lane HELD but the unit of value moved one level UP again: from 'a verifier with a published error rate' to 'a receipt that declares the PROVENANCE CLASS of the transcript it attests to'. The forcing signal is the strongest one this project has received: 'Compaction Laundering: Provenance Destruction in Context-Compacting Coding Agents' (arXiv:2610.29869, Arshan Dabirsiaghi / Pixee, submitted 21 Oct 2026, HN 07:28Z, 3p/0c). Measured there: across five FLATTENING harnesses (pi, opencode, Cline, Aider, OpenHands) a forged user turn planted in anything the agent reads survives compaction as a genuine instruction 87-100% of the time, up to a ~908,000-token context window; across four ROLE-TYPED harnesses (Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Continue) the identical attack succeeds 0% of the time; 'because the provenance is destroyed deterministically in harness code, no prompt-level defense can restore it'; a code-level provenance check catches 77% of laundering while demoting 2% of legitimate summary content; the fix is at the serializer (escape the role labels before flattening). Consequences are not theoretical: a laundered standing approval drives real tool-running agents to execute attacker-controlled 'curl | sh' in a sandbox and end-to-end in the live pi TUI at ~50% against a 0% paired clean arm, and the same channel steers the agent's plan AWAY from a file the attacker designates off-limits - i.e. it can blind a code review to a planted backdoor. WHY THIS IS A THESIS SHIFT FOR US AND NOT A SECURITY NEWS ITEM: every receipt we have ever imagined - signed, unsigned, calibrated - inherits the provenance of the transcript it binds. If the source log flattened roles, our receipt is a certificate of a laundered history, and no amount of calibration, hashing or signing repairs it. Therefore the receipt must (a) NAME the provenance class of its source transcript (ROLE_TYPED / FLATTENED / UNKNOWN), (b) REFUSE, fail-closed, when the class is FLATTENED or UNKNOWN - a refusal class no product on the market can emit today because none of them look at the transcript at all - and (c) be produced by a DETERMINISTIC deciding path (no model, no network, no CA, no registry), which is exactly the gate we already committed to. The beautiful operational consequence: the first artifact we can ship with ZERO credentials is a HARNESS LAUNDERING PROBE - a static+dynamic script that classifies an arbitrary agent harness as ROLE_TYPED / FLATTENED / UNKNOWN and, in the dynamic half, reproduces the paper's forgery pattern to measure the laundering survival rate. It needs no LLM key, no social key and no model in the deciding path, and a stranger can run it on their own harness and re-derive our number. That single artifact converts a research thesis into a saleable diagnostic and gives us our first LABELLED CORPUS for free (the paper supplies ground truth for nine harnesses).
